question: The volume of a cuboid is twice the volume of a cube. If the dimensions of the cuboid are 12 cm, 16 cm and 18 cm, then the total surface area of the cube is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of cuboid = 12 × 16 × 18 = 3456 cm³

Volume of cube = 3456 ÷ 2 = 1728 cm³

Side of cube (a) = 12 cm (since 12³ = 1728)

Total Surface Area = 6 × 12² = 6 × 144 = 864 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 864 cm².**
